scripts.dev: yarn db; concurrently "yarn filestore" "yarn graphql:dev" "yarn frontend:dev"
scripts.start: yarn filestore && (yarn db; concurrently -k "yarn graphql:start" "yarn frontend:start")
scripts.start:fresh: yarn db:reset && yarn db:seed && docker rm --force lwp-minio && yarn start
scripts.test: yarn test:jest && yarn test:vitest && yarn test:vitest:spm-dashboard
scripts.lint: yarn workspace graphql-provider lint && yarn workspace lwp-platform-frontend lint
scripts.lint:cache: yarn workspace graphql-provider lint:cache && yarn workspace lwp-platform-frontend lint:cache
scripts.lint:fix: yarn workspace graphql-provider lint:fix && yarn workspace lwp-platform-frontend lint:fix
scripts.test:playwright: yarn workspace e2e-tests run playwright test
scripts.test:playwright:smoke: yarn workspace e2e-tests run playwright test --grep "@(smoke|sanity)"
scripts.test:functional: dotenv yarn workspace graphql-provider run test:functional
scripts.test:functional:watch: dotenv yarn workspace graphql-provider run test:functional:watch
scripts.data-analytics-platform:build: dotenv yarn workspace data-analytics-platform run build
scripts.frontend:build: dotenv yarn workspace lwp-platform-frontend run build
scripts.analytics:build: dotenv yarn workspace data-analytics-platform run build
scripts.frontend:build:prod: dotenv yarn workspace lwp-platform-frontend run build:prod
scripts.frontend:dev: dotenv yarn workspace lwp-platform-frontend run dev
scripts.data-analytics-platform:dev: dotenv yarn workspace data-analytics-platform run dev
scripts.spm-dashboard:build: dotenv yarn workspace spm-dashboard run build
scripts.spm-dashboard:dev: dotenv yarn workspace spm-dashboard run dev
scripts.graphql:build: dotenv yarn workspace graphql-provider run build
scripts.graphql:dev: dotenv yarn workspace graphql-provider run dev
scripts.graphql:repl: dotenv yarn workspace graphql-provider start -- --entryFile repl
scripts._db: docker run --rm -d --name lwp-postgres -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=$PGSUPERPASSWORD -e POSTGRES_USER=$PGSUPERUSER -e POSTGRES_DB=$PGDATABASE -p $PGPORT:$PGPORT ghcr.io/poteris/pg_partman_cron:main
scripts.db:reset: dotenv yarn db:stop; docker rm --force lwp-postgres; dotenv yarn db:setup
scripts.db:setup: yarn db && yarn migrations:up && yarn db:enable-users
scripts.db:import-queries: dotenv yarn workspace graphql-provider start -- --entryFile scripts/import-data-queries
scripts.update-school-licences: dotenv yarn workspace graphql-provider start -- --entryFile scripts/update-school-licences
